About Bitdeer:

Bitdeer is a world-leading technology company for Bitcoin mining and AI cloud.

Bitdeer is committed to providing comprehensive Bitcoin mining solutions for its customers. Apart from designing industry-leading ASIC chips and manufacturing mining rigs, the Group handles complex processes involved in computing across the value chain. This includes equipment procurement, transport logistics, datacenter design and construction, equipment management, and network and facility operations. Bitdeer also offers advanced cloud capabilities to customers with a high demand for artificial intelligence.

Headquartered in Singapore, Bitdeer operates globally with a diversified 3 GW energy portfolio, and deploys Bitcoin mining and HPC datacenters in the United States, Bhutan, Norway, Canada, Malaysia, and Ethiopia.

About the team:

Our public-cloud GPU platform (10,000+ GPU, multi-region) runs 7×24 for external customers under SLA. As a Cloud Operations & Support Engineer you are the front line: within each shift you both handle customer tickets and monitor platform health / respond to alerts (NOC) — triaging, resolving what you can, and escalating cleanly. This is a dual-responsibility, follow-the-sun role across regions.

What you will be responsible for:

  • Handle customer support tickets and requests: intake, triage, troubleshooting, resolution, and clear status communication within SLA response / resolution targets.
  • Monitor platform health and respond to alerts (NOC first response): acknowledge, assess severity, initiate incident handling, and post customer-facing status updates.
  • Troubleshoot common issues across GPU instances, VM / bare metal, networking, drivers / CUDA, storage, and billing / quota, using runbooks.
  • Escalate cleanly along the chain (L1/L2 → L3 → SRE / Compute / R&D) with full context; never leave a ticket or alert unowned.
  • Maintain and improve runbooks, knowledge base, and canned responses.
  • Participate in a follow-the-sun 7×24 shift rotation across regions.
  • Track and report ticket / alert metrics (response time, resolution time, MTTA).

How you will stand out:

  • 1+ years (Middle: 3+) in cloud / technical support, NOC, or IT operations; strong new grads considered for L1.
  • Solid Linux, networking, and cloud basics; methodical troubleshooting.
  • Familiarity with GPU / CUDA, containers, VM / bare metal, or storage is a strong plus (trainable for the rest).
  • Strong written English and customer communication; calm under incidents.
  • Discipline to follow runbooks and escalate correctly.
  • Willing to work shifts (follow-the-sun; region-local daytime where possible).

What you will experience working with us:

  • A culture that values authenticity and diversity of thoughts and backgrounds;
  • An inclusive and respectable environment with open workspaces and exciting start-up spirit;
  • Fast-growing company with the chance to network with industrial pioneers and enthusiasts;
  • Ability to contribute directly and make an impact on the future of the digital asset industry;
  • Involvement in new projects, developing processes/systems;
  • Personal accountability, autonomy, fast growth, and learning opportunities;
  • Attractive welfare benefits and developmental opportunities such as training and mentoring.

About the opportunity

We're building PayMoji, the app that lets travelers pay like a local with native QR codes across Southeast Asia 🌏. No bulky wallets, no ATM hunting 🏧, no brutal withdrawal fees. Just scan and Pay 📲. We are currently already live in Vietnam and in the Philippines (Google Play · App Store).

We already run promoted content with Instagram and YouTube creators and are looking for more. Come to us with their own idea of a partnership, and build something with us over time 🤝.

So we're flipping the usual brief. You tell us how you'd work with PayMoji. Your format, your audience, your rate.

We're focused on Vietnam 🇻🇳 and the Philippines 🇵🇭, opening soon to Thailand 🇹🇭 and Cambodia 🇰🇭 — reach out early if that's your patch.

Who we're looking for

We're open on size. A 4,000-person Facebook group of expats in Cebu can be worth more to us than 400,000 passive followers 📈.

  • Travel & nomad creators — Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, Reels, Shorts, long-form, whatever you're good at 🎥

  • Community leaders & organizers — Facebook groups, Discords, Telegram channels, WhatsApp communities, coworking and hostel crowds, meetup hosts 🏘️

  • Local voices — Vietnamese or Filipino creators who can explain the local payment world to visitors, in either direction 🗣️

  • Niche and weird is welcome — motorbike touring, diving, budget travel, digital nomad finance, solo female travel, food hunting 🍜

What matters to us:

  • You have a real audience of travelers, nomads, or expats in Vietnam or the Philippines 🌅

  • You've experienced real-world challenges when paying with cash, credit cards, and/or QR codes in SEA

  • You're straight with your audience — no fake hype, no spam 🚫

  • You can run a collaboration on your own and communicate clearly from the road

What a partnership could look like

Pick what fits you. Mix them. Or pitch something we haven't thought of 💡

  • Content — Reels, Shorts, TikToks, a YouTube segment, a full review, a "1 week paying only by QR" challenge 🎬

  • Community — an AMA in your group, a pinned guide, a walkthrough post, a small meetup or workshop ☕

  • Affiliate / referral — your own code, you earn per new active user 🔗

  • Long-term ambassador — ongoing collaboration, early access to features, a say in the roadmap 🛠️

  • Content we license — you shoot it, we run it as paid media too (paid separately) 📺

  • Local market work — merchant intros, on-the-ground QR mapping, helping us understand your city 🗺️

Why collaborate with us

  • 💰 You name your price. Flat fee, per-post, CPM, affiliate, revenue share, hybrid — bring your rate card, we'll talk.

  • 🚀 Early on something real. PayMoji is live in the stores and growing across Southeast Asia. Get in before everyone else does.

  • 🧘 Fits your life. No desk, no daily calls. Your office is the cafe, the night market, the hostel rooftop.

  • 🎁 Perks beyond cash. Credit in the app to test with, early access to features, and your feedback going straight to the people building it.

  • 🚪 Room to grow. Great partners get bigger budgets, new markets, and first pick on what's next.

How to apply 📝

Fill in the application form:

  • Check out our app — Google Play · App Store

  • Be specific in your answers

  • Come with a number. Even a rough one. We'd rather negotiate than guess

We’re looking forward to hearing from you!
descriptions.job-0l8dfq1:
Lightspark is creating the Money Grid, modern, open financial infrastructure that makes payments accessible, affordable, and instant for businesses and users worldwide. We're challenging the status quo, updating the current system, and empowering our partners to build better solutions. Together, we're building the most advanced financial infrastructure, open, instant, and global, inspiring a future where anyone, anywhere can access the full potential of digital money.

We are looking for engineers who enjoy building and shipping quickly, learning how other teams work, and seeing their work change how an entire company operates. As a Senior Software Engineer on the Data & AI team, you'll expand Lighthouse, our internal data and AI platform, into the layer that lets every function at Lightspark run on trusted data and AI agents.

Most of the value in applied AI comes from the connective work: wiring models to a company's data, its tools, and the way people actually work, then getting the result adopted. We've built that layer for analytics, where Lighthouse now handles most of what our team used to do by hand and is used across the company. This role extends it to Sales, Finance, Ops, Legal, Compliance, and Partnerships: the agent harness, tool integrations, governed source-of-truth data, and the execution layer those teams run their workflows on. General-purpose assistants get partway there and miss things; you'll build the structure underneath so the answers are right, repeatable, and owned by the teams that need them.

You'll work on a small, senior team with a lot of ownership. Problems come from talking with the teams you support rather than from a spec; you'll scope them, ship the solution, and make sure it sticks.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING:

  • Building and owning our internal AI platform: the agent harness, MCP servers and tool integrations, context and access services, sandboxed execution, and cost and usage tracking

  • Embedding with Finance, Sales Ops, Compliance, and onboarding to understand how their work actually happens, then shipping the systems that replace the manual version and handing them off to those teams

  • Extending our data infrastructure alongside our Staff Data Engineer: DBT models, BigQuery, orchestration, and the production pipelines

  • Sharing ownership of monitoring, alerting, and data reliability for the systems that unblock product launches

  • Partnering with Engineering to optimize their own dev systems and tooling

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:

  • 4+ years experience shipping and maintaining production systems; data engineering, ML engineering, and backend/full-stack backgrounds all fit

  • You've built an internal platform or workflow system that other teams adopted, not just features on top of one

  • You've built with LLM APIs, agent frameworks, and MCP in production, beyond prompting, and you know what belongs in code versus a model

  • Strong fundamentals in TypeScript/Node or Python and the willingness to work in both, plus fluency with a cloud data warehouse such as BigQuery, Snowflake, or Databricks

  • You can sit with a non-technical team, understand how their work actually happens, and come back with a system

  • Comfortable working with ambiguity in a startup environment

  • Experience in payments, crypto, or blockchain is a plus, but not required

  • Based in LA or Openness to relocate to Los Angeles, California

This is not an ML infrastructure, model-training, or prompt-engineering role. You might currently be an AI engineer, ML engineer, data engineer, or full-stack engineer who has spent the last year or two building agents and internal tooling. If you don't match every line above but have built systems like these, we'd like to hear from you.

Lightspark is on a mission to build the future of open, instant, and global financial infrastructure making payments accessible and affordable for everyone, everywhere. We're committed to creating a more inclusive and diverse workplace to reflect the customers we serve. We welcome interest from individuals of all backgrounds and levels of experience who share our mission. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

We will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of the State of California Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring.

Description

Role location and working style: 

This is position is based in Manhattan, NYC Metropolitan Area, with an in-office and hybrid set up. Remote set up is not possible.


About eToro: 

eToro is the platform where you can trade, invest, save, and spend. Founded in 2007 with the vision of a world where everyone can trade and invest in a simple and transparent way, we've built a regulated, Nasdaq-listed platform used by millions of people in 75 countries. 

We believe there is power in shared knowledge. By combining the collective intelligence of our community with AI-powered tools, we've created a collaborative investment community designed to help you grow your knowledge and wealth.  

On eToro, you can hold a range of traditional and innovative assets and choose how you invest: trade directly, invest in a portfolio, copy other investors, or invest with an AI agent. Visit our Media Centre for the latest news. 

You can find out more about eToro here. 


Role Summary

We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented accounting professional to join our US Finance team. This role supports our crypto, money service business (MSB), and broker-dealer operations - all of which have grown significantly as eToro expands its regulated US footprint.

You will support the US Financial Controller across all accounting matters, with emphasis on financial reporting, regulatory reporting, internal controls, tax, and treasury management. As a now-public company, the scope and visibility of this role are substantial, and you will have real opportunity to grow your impact alongside the business.


﻿Key Responsibilities

You’ll play a key role in supporting eToro’s regulated US entities, combining hands-on accounting with regulatory reporting, controls, automation and digital asset operations.

  • Own key elements of the month-end close, including journal entries, reconciliations, variance analysis, forecasting and management reporting.
  • Ensure financial reporting remains compliant with US GAAP and applicable regulatory requirements.
  • Support regulatory reporting across our US entities, including FOCUS reports, NMLS call reports, DFS reporting and transaction-level reporting for MSB and Virtual Currency operations.
  • Partner with the US Controller and global Finance teams on intercompany reconciliations, cash postings, prepaid expenses, fixed assets and accounting adjustments.
  • Support our evolving crypto and digital asset operations, including custody processes and digital asset accounting requirements.
  • Manage core Accounts Payable activities, including vendors, invoices, purchase orders, wires and corporate spend platforms such as Brex and Expensify.
  • Support financial, regulatory and tax audits, ensuring requests are accurate, complete and delivered on time.
  • Own client and vendor tax reporting requirements, including W-9, W-8 and 1099 reporting, working alongside external tax advisors.
  • Identify control gaps and build stronger, scalable processes that improve accuracy and audit readiness.
  • Use automation and AI-enabled tools to streamline finance workflows, reduce manual work and accelerate the month-end close.
  • Take ownership of ad hoc projects and evolving priorities across multiple regulated US entities.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of accounting experience, ideally combining public accounting with industry experience.
  • Experience within a broker-dealer, fintech, financial services or regulated environment is strongly preferred.
  • Degree in Accounting, Finance or a related discipline.
  • CPA preferred; Series 27 or 28 would be a strong advantage.
  • Experience working with ERP and finance systems such as NetSuite, QuickBooks or Priority.
  • Strong understanding of financial controls, reconciliations and month-end close processes.
  • A track record of automating, simplifying or improving finance processes rather than simply maintaining them.
  • Comfortable managing multiple priorities and collaborating with colleagues across different teams and time zones.
  • Strong communication skills and the confidence to take ownership.
  • Curiosity about crypto, blockchain and digital assets, and an interest in how the financial landscape is evolving.


What we offer:

  • Salary range for this role is $85,000 - $100,000 per annum
  • Comprehensive benefits package
  • Cell phone stipend
  • Daily lunch allowance
  • Gym stipend
  • 6% 401K match
  • 100% insurance coverage for the employee
  • Additional leave / recharge days
  • eToro trading credits


﻿Our Hiring Philosophy: 

At eToro, AI is changing how we build, work and make decisions, and our hiring approach reflects that. We are building an AI-first organisation where people are encouraged to use AI thoughtfully. 

That starts with how we hire. Throughout our recruitment process, we may use AI-enabled tools, including interview notetakers and other technologies that help us capture information accurately, improve consistency and create a better experience for candidates and interviewers. These tools support our feedback and assessment outcomes. Hiring decisions remain grounded in running fair and consistent interview processes, human judgement, critical thinking, and thorough evaluation of experience, ability and motivation that are aligned to our business and role requirements. 

We also want candidates to be comfortable working with AI. Depending on the role, we may explore how you use AI tools in your day-to-day work, how you think about their opportunities and limitations, and how you would contribute to eToro’s continued AI build-out. 

For us, being AI-first is not about replacing human judgement. It is about combining human expertise, creativity and accountability with technology that helps us do our best work and accelerate our growth. In the end, that's what we're hiring for: human insight, supercharged by AI.

  • Recruiter Intro: Explore your experience, motivations, and alignment with the role.

Life at TRM

We are building a safer world. That promise shows up in how we work every day.

TRM moves quickly. We are a high velocity, high ownership team that expects clarity, follow-through, and impact. People who thrive here are energized by hard problems, experimentation, and continuous feedback. If something takes months elsewhere, it will ship here in days.

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly.   • Work that often requires operating with a high degree of ambiguity

  • Close collaboration across teams and functions

  • Frequent, high-touch communication

  • Creative problem solving and out-of-the-box thinking

  • A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

At the same time, many people find this work deeply rewarding. If you are excited by meaningful problems, motivated by ambitious goals, and energized by working alongside mission-driven colleagues, there is a good chance you will find TRM to be an exceptional place to grow and contribute. AI Fluency at TRM

  • Increase speed and leverage

Join our Mission

At TRM we care deeply about our craft. We are looking for individuals who want their work to matter, who experiment with speed and rigor, and who take pride in building a safer world for billions of people. If you’re excited by TRM’s mission but don’t check every box, we encourage you to apply — we hire for slope, judgment, and the will to learn fast.

You do not need a whole career in crypto. You should care about how AI is changing both how we build and what people want, and you should want to build for collectors, creators, communities, and marketplaces.

Deployment Strategist in the Palantir sense. The strategist, not the engineer.

Interviews start in August

Rain is hiring a Senior Product Data Analyst to be the analytical engine behind our product team. Payments and stablecoin infrastructure generate enormous, rich, and consequential datasets — authorization patterns, ledger movements, partner usage, cardholder behavior — and the decisions we make on top of that data shape the experience for our partners and millions of their end users.

This is a senior individual contributor role embedded directly with product. You'll partner with PMs, engineers, and partnerships leads to turn raw data into the sharpest possible product judgment: defining metrics, designing experiments, sizing opportunities, and pulling on the threads that reveal where the product is working and where it isn't. Sphere built the system that solves it. As the Founding Forward Deployed Engineer at Sphere, you’ll embed directly with Sphere's most strategic customers to understand their cross-border business workflows, identify the highest-impact compliance challenges, and design and deliver custom solutions that make Sphere fit seamlessly into their operations.

Enablement

  • Guide clients through the complexity of understanding and managing their global tax liability

Monetization

  • Be entrenched with the customer by ensuring Sphere is integral to all of the company’s revenue compliance needs

Our work sits at the intersection of AI, national security, and fighting crime. The problems are complex, the stakes are real, and the environment evolves quickly.   • Frequent, high-touch communication

  • Creative problem solving and out-of-the-box thinking

  • A pace that rewards urgency, adaptability, and outcomes

We also recognize that this style of operating is not for everyone. AI Fluency at TRM
